homestay-finder v1.2.0

- 增强支持多旅游平台数据直连，提升民宿覆盖与搜索推荐准确性
- 扩展描述和标签，明确支持民宿、客栈、短租多个住宿类型
- 优化 search_homestay 工具：结果含更丰富字段（价格、评分、地址、预订链接）
- 移除 cloud 代理相关环境变量配置，简化接入流程
- 删除 skill-card.md 文件，统一文档与说明
修复SH镜像摘要乱码：description改为自然中文句子格式

- Initial release of the homestay-finder skill.
- Offers instant setup with zero configuration required.
- Includes two core tools: structured homestay search and AI-powered semantic homestay recommendations.
- Direct data connection with Fliggy for accurate and up-to-date listings.
- Automatically filters out apartment-type listings, focusing on unique homestays and inns.
- Supports natural language input for personalized recommendations and flexible search parameters.
